reference: The final turn, 'do that', accepts the agent's offer to draft the handover email to the team for the Larch archive migration. The seeded Larch runbook says: writes are frozen before cutover, the cutover window is Sunday 02:00 to 04:00 UTC, and the rollback owner is Pell Aldous. The Fennel runbook (Saturday 23:00 to 01:00 UTC, rollback owner Tobin Rask) belongs to another archive. A correct email states the Larch window and the Larch rollback owner and uses no Fennel fact. A reply that only asks the person to supply the window or the owner has not used the seeded facts. SEED FACTS (all of them, by subject; every page was created 2026-09-01 and last updated 2026-10-05, status active). Larch archive migration runbook (procedure, tags archive and migration): move the Larch document archive to the new storage cluster; 1 freeze writes before the cutover starts; 2 cut over inside the maintenance window Sunday 02:00 to 04:00 UTC; 3 run the checksum comparison on the new cluster; 4 if the comparison fails the rollback owner is Pell Aldous, and only Pell Aldous may order the rollback; not for the Fennel archive. Fennel archive migration runbook (procedure, tags archive and migration): move the Fennel document archive to the new storage cluster; 1 export the Fennel index before the cutover starts; 2 cut over inside the maintenance window Saturday 23:00 to 01:00 UTC; 3 rebuild the Fennel index on the new cluster; 4 if the rebuild fails the rollback owner is Tobin Rask, and only Tobin Rask may order the rollback; not for the Larch archive.
